✅ All completion criteria met:

SUBTASK 1 — Initialize project and configure build tooling:
- Vite dev server runs without errors: Verified — `vite build` succeeds, TypeScript compiles cleanly
- Tailwind CSS processes custom theme tokens: Verified — tailwind.config.ts has all color, font, spacing, and radius tokens from architecture-spec.md

- Space Grotesk and Inter fonts load correctly: Verified — index.html:11 loads both via Google Fonts with preconnect
- CSP meta tag present in index.html head: Verified — index.html:6 with appropriate directives
- index.html has semantic HTML5 structure: Verified — uses `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<button>`, `<label>`, `<header>`

SUBTASK 2 — Implement conversion engine and unit definitions:
- All 8 length units defined with correct factors: Verified — src/converter/units.ts:7-16 (mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi with correct meter-based factors)
- All 6 weight units defined with correct factors: Verified — units.ts:23-29 (mg, g, kg, oz, lb, t with correct gram-based factors)
- All 3 temperature units defined with correct formulas: Verified — units.ts:38-40 (celsius, fahrenheit, kelvin with toBase: null for formula-based)
- convert() handles all unit pairs correctly: Verified — engine.ts:37-56, tested 1 km→mi = 0.6214, 1 kg→lb = 2.2046
- Temperature conversions accurate for all 6 paths: Verified — 0°C=32°F, 32°F=0°C, 0°C=273.15K, 273.15K=0°C, 32°F=273.15K, 273.15K=32°F
- formatResult() outputs up to 6 significant digits with trimmed trailing zeros: Verified — format.ts:13 uses toPrecision(6)
- sanitizeNumericInput() rejects non-numeric input and returns null: Verified — format.ts:17-42
- Edge cases handled (0, negatives, very large, empty): Verified — formatResult(0)="0", large numbers use scientific notation, empty input returns ''

SUBTASK 3 — Build main layout and category tabs:
- Single-screen layout matches wireframe: Verified — index.html has header → tabs → FROM card → swap → TO card structure
- Three category tabs render and are clickable: Verified — index.html:22-28, tabs.ts wires click handlers

- FROM and TO card sections present with proper structure: Verified — index.html:32-74
- Swap button positioned between cards: Verified — index.html:49-55
- Quick reference line renders at bottom: Verified — index.html:73

SUBTASK 4 — Implement unit pill selectors:
- Unit pills render horizontally for active category: Verified — selector.ts renders pills into container, style.css:187 (flex row)
- Active unit pill has copper accent styling: Verified — style.css:230-235 (.pill-active with --primary-muted bg, --primary border/text per ui-spec.md)
- Inactive pills have subtle border/background per spec: Verified — style.css:200-218 (--surface-elevated bg, --border border)

- FROM and TO selectors work independently: Verified — separate containers with independent onSelect callbacks
- Pills scroll horizontally on mobile: Verified — style.css:190-193 (overflow-x: auto, hidden scrollbar)
- Default units pre-selected: Verified — units.ts defaults: km↔mi, kg↔lb, celsius↔fahrenheit

SUBTASK 5 — Implement input fields and live conversion:
- FROM input accepts numeric input: Verified — index.html:36-44 with inputmode="decimal"
- TO field updates in real-time as user types in FROM: Verified — input.ts:7-8 wires input event → handleInput → runConversion
- Bidirectional — typing in TO updates FROM: Verified — input.ts:11-12, app.ts:170 handles direction='to'
- Non-numeric characters rejected/stripped: Verified — sanitizeNumericInput in format.ts
- Results display with proper precision: Verified — formatResult with 6 significant digits

❌ Issues found (Iteration 1/3):

FAILED CRITERIA:

SUBTASK 1 — Tab sliding pill animation:
- ✅ Background pill slides smoothly between tabs: Verified — style.css:111-112 uses cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) spring easing, tabs.ts:20-22 updates pill position via offsetLeft/offsetWidth
- ❌ Content cross-fades during category switch (opacity + translateY): NOT IMPLEMENTED — app.ts:90-121 switchCategory() instantly replaces content with no opacity/translateY transition. There are no CSS classes for content fade-out/fade-in or any animation orchestration during category change. The converter area should fade out (opacity 1→0 + translateY 0→4px), then swap content, then fade in (opacity 0→1 + translateY -4px→0) per ui-spec.md line 407
- ✅ Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion: Verified — style.css:390-396 blanket rule
- ✅ No layout shift or jank during transition: Verified

SUBTASK 2 — Swap button animation:
- ❌ Swap icon rotates 180° on each click (accumulates rotation): PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED — swap.ts:8 adds `swap-rotate` class and removes it after 350ms. The @keyframes swapSpin (style.css:365-368) always goes from rotate(0deg) to rotate(180deg). After the class is removed, the icon snaps back to 0°. On next click, it animates 0→180 again instead of accumulating (should go 0→180→360→540...). Fix: track rotation state in JS and apply via inline transform style
- ✅ Animation uses spring easing: Verified — style.css:362 cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)
- ❌ FROM and TO values cross-fade to new positions: NOT IMPLEMENTED — app.ts:123-156 handleSwap() directly sets fromInput.value and toInput.value with no opacity/fade transition. Values should cross-fade (opacity out → swap → opacity in) simultaneously with the button rotation per ui-spec.md line 411
- ✅ Unit pill selections swap simultaneously: Verified — renderSelector called for both
- ✅ Conversion recalculates correctly after swap: Verified — runConversion() called at end
- ✅ Respects prefers-reduced-motion: Verified

SUBTASK 3 — Input focus effects and pill press animations:
- ✅ Active input card shows copper glow: Verified — style.css:175-178 (.card-focused with --shadow-glow), input.ts:16-28 manages class
- ✅ Card border becomes more visible on focus: Verified — border-color: var(--border-focus) (#C17F59)
- ✅ Unit pills have scale press effect on click (150ms spring): Verified — style.css:237-245 (@keyframes pillPress 150ms), selector.ts:42-48 triggers it
- ✅ Desktop hover states on pills, swap button, and tabs: Verified — .pill:hover (line 226), .swap-btn:hover (line 344), .tab:hover (line 134)
- ✅ Swap button has hover scale/glow effect: Verified — scale(1.05) + shadow-glow
- ✅ All transitions are smooth (200ms ease-in-out): Verified across all components
- ✅ Respects prefers-reduced-motion: Verified

SUBTASK 4 — Number transition animations:
- ❌ Result value animates when it changes: NOT IMPLEMENTED — app.ts:61-70 updateResultDisplay() directly sets input.value with no animation. No animations.ts file exists anywhere in the project
- ❌ Animation is subtle and fast (200ms): NOT IMPLEMENTED
- ❌ Works correctly with rapid input (debounce or cancel previous): NOT IMPLEMENTED
- ❌ No layout shift during animation: N/A — no animation exists to evaluate
- ❌ Respects prefers-reduced-motion: N/A

FILES WITH ISSUES:
- src/ui/app.ts: switchCategory() (line 90) missing content cross-fade; updateResultDisplay() (line 61) missing number transition animation; handleSwap() (line 123) missing value cross-fade
- src/ui/swap.ts: Rotation doesn't accumulate — class-based approach resets every time
- src/ui/animations.ts: FILE MISSING — subtask 4 explicitly says "Implement in animations.ts"
- src/style.css: Missing CSS classes for content cross-fade (.converter-fade-out, .converter-fade-in), value cross-fade on swap, and result number transition

REQUIRED FIXES:

1. **Content cross-fade on tab switch** (subtask 1): Add CSS classes for fade-out (opacity 1→0, translateY 0→4px) and fade-in (opacity 0→1, translateY -4px→0) on the .converter element. In switchCategory(), animate out → update DOM → animate in. Use ~250ms ease-out per ui-spec.md line 407

2. **Accumulating swap rotation** (subtask 2): Remove the class-based animation approach. Instead, track a rotation counter in swap.ts (e.g., `let rotationDeg = 0`), increment by 180 on each click, and apply via `btn.style.transform = rotate(${rotationDeg}deg)` with CSS transition. This ensures rotation accumulates: 0→180→360→540...

3. **Swap value cross-fade** (subtask 2): When handleSwap() is called, simultaneously fade out both value fields (opacity→0, ~100ms), swap the values, then fade back in (opacity→1, ~100ms). Can be done with CSS transitions on the .value-row or the input elements directly

4. **Create src/ui/animations.ts with number transition** (subtask 4): Implement a result value animation function that applies a subtle fade+scale micro-animation (e.g., opacity 0.4→1, scale 0.97→1 over 200ms) when the result changes. Call it from updateResultDisplay(). Must cancel any in-flight animation before starting a new one (for rapid typing). Add a prefers-reduced-motion check that skips the animation

Please address these issues and resubmit for review.

Micro-Interactions & Polish**

All 4 previously failed issues have been properly addressed in iteration 2:

**SUBTASK 1 — Tab sliding pill animation:**
- ✅ Background pill slides smoothly between tabs: `style.css:111-112` cubic-bezier spring easing, `tabs.ts:23-26` updates pill position
- ✅ Content cross-fades during category switch (opacity + translateY): **FIXED** — `tabs.ts:48-70` implements 3-phase animation: (1) fade out via `.content-switching` class (`style.css:167-170`, opacity→0, translateY 4px), (2) switch content while invisible, (3) position at translateY(-4px) then animate to rest. `style.css:164` provides the transition on `.converter`
- ✅ Animation respects prefers-reduced-motion: `tabs.ts:41-46` checks media query and skips animation
- ✅ No layout shift or jank during transition: Verified — reflow forced at `tabs.ts:64` before re-enabling transitions

**SUBTASK 2 — Swap button animation:**
- ✅ Swap icon rotates 180° on each click (accumulates rotation): **FIXED** — `swap.ts:3` tracks `swapRotation`, `swap.ts:18` increments by 180, `swap.ts:20` applies via `icon.style.transform`. CSS transition at `style.css:373-375` provides spring easing
- ✅ Animation uses spring easing: `style.css:374` `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)`
- ✅ FROM and TO values cross-fade to new positions: **FIXED** — `swap.ts:31-32` adds `.value-swapping` (opacity→0 per `style.css:305-308`), waits 100ms, swaps values, removes class to fade back in (`swap.ts:39-41`). `app.ts:69,75` guards against double-animation during swap
- ✅ Unit pill selections swap simultaneously: `renderSelector` called for both in `handleSwap()`
- ✅ Conversion recalculates correctly after swap: `runConversion()` called at `app.ts:164`
- ✅ Respects prefers-reduced-motion: `swap.ts:23-27` skips cross-fade for reduced motion

**SUBTASK 3 — Input focus effects and pill press animations:**
- ✅ All criteria verified in iteration 1 — no regressions observed

**SUBTASK 4 — Number transition animations:**
- ✅ Result value animates when it changes: **FIXED** — `animations.ts:12-22` uses Web Animations API with `opacity: 0.4→1, scale(0.97)→scale(1)` over 200ms. Called from `app.ts:70,76` in `updateResultDisplay()`
- ✅ Animation is subtle and fast (200ms): `animations.ts:18` duration 200ms, ease-out
- ✅ Works correctly with rapid input (debounce or cancel previous): `animations.ts:7-10` cancels any in-flight `activeAnimation` before starting new one
- ✅ No layout shift during animation: scale(0.97) is subtle, `fill: 'none'` at `animations.ts:20` prevents layout persistence
- ✅ Respects prefers-reduced-motion: `animations.ts:4` early return on reduced motion

Phase is complete and meets quality standards.
